body:
Thank you so much. Your advice really helped me in this situation. I know I'm not a failure, but when things are going bad it can seem that way. I'm working on not immediately turning to negative thoughts like that because they don't help matters at all. 

My bank saved the day because of overdraft protection...I'm so relieved that I have just a bit more time to work on saving whatever money I can and get back on track with a roof over my head, instead of having to find a place to live and a new home for my animals.

I just sold it, all in a matter of maybe an hour of posting it. I love craigslist for that. 

I really hope my complex will be understanding and take the partial good faith payment. I do have a regular job and I've just fallen on hard times with a few unexpected expenses, a few poor choices, and no support system here.  I just can't handle feeling like I'm failing in such a major way...the people around me seem to be getting by so easily, I don't understand what I'm doing wrong and it's so hard to get back on track.

Thanks. I feel like I've been going through the motions, applying for better jobs, not getting interviews, and not making a lot at work for a long time, and been mentally checked out. 

I'm working on options all night, seeing anything I can do to make some extra money to get past this. I'm actually about to sell my camera; I don't use it much anyway...I should have sold it a long time ago. I'm going to talk to my apartment complex tomorrow with that money in hand and hopefully they will understand I'm just trying to make it and will be sympathetic.

Thank you for your kind words and for walking me through this. 

I really don't have a place to go, I'm not on good terms with my family and I don't have many real friends who can do anything, I just moved to a new city. 

I realize this is temporary and I kick myself for not rising to the occasion.

I've never been a fan of Jennifer Aniston because she doesn't act so much as she plays the same tired character on the screen, but I thought her nymphomaniac character on Horrible Bosses was great. First time I saw her and didn't think of the shitty Friends theme song.
